requestedArea: S13 断镐石场（用户确认）
changes: Centralize model run/walk constants in ChapterGame and reduce ordinary native-character movement to 4m/s.
Keep slow walk at 1.6m/s by deriving input scaling from the new run-speed constant. Manual movement and automation share GameSession movement; animation already follows measured displacement.
Add explicit PureCombat/EnemyCombat field types to fix existing cyclic type inference exposed by the current core checks; no combat behavior changes.

verification.defaultPreview: 7469 rebuilt; boot S01-T1 with movementSpeed=4, frameRate setting=60, no page errors

causality.interpretation: Lower movement speed reduces distance-triggered exploration work, but the quarry draws essentially the same geometry per frame. Speed is not established as the sole thermal cause.
causality.limits: Short controlled desktop Web sample using game time and software GPU, not phone temperature, power or true phone FPS. A fresh chart-memory fixture is used for each accepted run; earlier cache-contaminated exploration comparisons were discarded.

sourceInventory.note: Generated BuildInfo changes with packaging. Concurrent CombatLoadouts changes were preserved and are not movement-speed edits; this inventory is not claimed to be an immutable manifest of every packaged source file.
